svg.text: 20 × 8 holes (0.1 in pitch), strips horizontal. Matches the fuzz-face-2n3904 schematic; nets auto-checked.
Cut all 6 tracks first; check each with a meter.
Holes are named by row letter + column, e.g. D10.
Q1 flat face left, Q2 flat face right (the flat
read E-B-C when you face the flat side.
R1A and R2 lie along their strip over a cut.
VR1 assumes an inline-pin trimmer (A-W-B in
a row). Check yours; the W and B pins must
both reach strip D/E via the D18–E18 link.
VOL 2 → J2 tip: wire directly, off-board.
Bias: no signal, meter red on Q2 C (strip D,
11–20), black on GND. Set VR1 for ≈ 4.5 V.
